welcome.title: In front of something moving
welcome.text: For this round you need something that moves behind your hands: a running fan, or a TV or monitor playing a video or a game with nothing private on it. With neither, stop here and pick another round. Steps without windows come first, then a window will appear: it doesn't move or click.|Press the button on the right side of the headset to start each step. Pressed while recording, it pauses.

done.title: All done
done.text: Thank you! This recording session will close. Continue in the application.|Review your recordings in the Hand recorder window.

stopped.title: Stopped
stopped.text: What was recorded so far is saved. Review it in the Hand recorder window.

sections.title: Hand size
sections.intro: First, your hand size: both hands up about 40 cm out, still.

prompts.text: Both hands about 40 cm out, still|Palms toward you

switch.text: Both hands about 40 cm out, still|Backs toward you

sections.title: In front of something moving
sections.intro: Face a running fan, out of reach, or a TV or monitor playing something fast with nothing private on it (a video or a game), one to two metres away. The steps call it the moving thing. Keep it behind your hands for the whole round: the cameras should see your hand with the movement behind it.

prompts.text: Right hand up between you and the moving thing, about 40 cm out, palm toward you, fingers spread.|Hold it still.

switch.text: Right hand up between you and the moving thing, about 40 cm out, back of the hand toward you, fingers spread.|Hold it still.

prompts.text: Left hand up between you and the moving thing, about 40 cm out, palm toward you, fingers spread.|Hold it still.

switch.text: Left hand up between you and the moving thing, about 40 cm out, back of the hand toward you, fingers spread.|Hold it still.

prompts.text: Hand open, about 40 cm out. Move it slowly across the moving thing and back, side to side, then up and down,|so it passes in front of every part of it.
Hand in front of the moving thing, palm toward you. Bend each finger all the way down and back up,|one at a time, thumb to little finger.
Keep the hand in front of it. Tap thumb to index a few times, then thumb to middle,|opening the hand between taps, as you would to click.
Still in front of it: make a fist and open it, point, pinch and let go,|a new shape every second or two.
Move the hand to the edge of the moving thing, half in front of it and half beside it,|then in and out across that edge, fingers moving.
Both hands in front of it, about 40 cm out, each doing its own thing:|one tapping while the other opens and closes, or anything else.

switch.to: one hand passing in front of the other

sections.title: Taps in front of it
sections.intro: Keep facing the moving thing: a window will appear in front of it. Tap as each button says. Nothing happens when you tap: the cameras record your hand.

prompts.text: Right hand up, about 40 cm out, in front of the moving thing. Cyan: tap thumb to index. Purple: thumb to middle.|Orange with a cross: stop about 1 cm short, without touching.
Left hand up, about 40 cm out, in front of the moving thing. Cyan: tap thumb to index. Purple: thumb to middle.|Orange with a cross: stop about 1 cm short, without touching.
Both hands up in front of the moving thing. Each lit button says L or R: tap with that hand.|Cyan thumb to index, purple thumb to middle, orange with a cross stop short.
